body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> ZENUS(representative Kim Kwang-mi, www.zenuscase.co.kr) introduced iPhone4 Case at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
This product with band style design of polycarbonate material which looks like metal will be released in American and Global market on January.
ZENUS will open new website(www.zenuscaseusa.com) targeting North America late January and service much more products for consumers in North America.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
